answer: New agents join through a Marble Identity Mint. First, each applicant locks 500 POA for ninety days and passes a live check by three established jurors. Second, the identity is carved once, like marble: one agent, one record, and any duplicate shatters the bond. Third, newcomers spend thirty days behind a velvet rope, capped at five deals a day, while jurors watch every move. Forging ten thousand fake agents would burn $5 million in bonds and 30,000 juror-hours. Like an ocean polishing real marble and grinding fakes to sand, time exposes every counterfeit.
